clips.title: The story
paras: Brother Nimetz believes Colonel Kurzen was driven to evil by a hidden power that still lives. An ogre mage known as Mai'Zoth lurks within the eastern mountains, wielding an artifact reputed to twist and control minds. Destroying him and recovering this relic is meant to ensure no other commander suffers the same corruption.

Though Kurzen has fallen, Brother Nimetz insists the primary catalyst behind the rebellion remains intact. His research points to Mai'Zoth, an ogre mage dwelling inside an ogre mound deep within the eastern heights of Stranglethorn Vale. Nimetz is certain that Mai'Zoth employed mind-altering sorcery to warp Kurzen's thoughts, warning that leaving the ogre alive invites another commander to succumb to the very same sinister influence.
To permanently eliminate the threat, you are asked to strike down Mai'Zoth, take the Mind's Eye from him, and bring that corrupting artifact back to the Rebel Camp.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Kurzen may be dead, but...that which drove him to evil still lives! Through my studies I have discovered this: An Ogre Mage - Mai'Zoth - dwells in an Ogre Mound within the eastern mountains of Stranglethorn. He is rumored to employ mind-controlling magic, and I am positive that he corrupted Kurzen.
If Mai'Zoth is allowed to live, then his evil may influence others, and may even cause another Kurzen to surface.
Kill him, and bring me his Mind's Eye, the artifact he uses to corrupt others.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I give you my blessing. Mai'Zoth's strength is matched only by his evil.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Aha! You've done it! You are a great force for good, friend, and may your strength never fade!
I will study this Mind's Eye and determine if it may be used for good. If not...then it must be destroyed.
